topics.label: Introduction and Course Overview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the course structure, learning outcomes, and broad conceptual framework of cancer biology.

topics.label: Cancer as a Failure of Cellular Differentiation and Architecture
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how the accumulation of genetic and epigenetic alterations leads to a breakdown in normal developmental differentiation, tissue architecture, and in vitro modeling.

topics.label: Invasion, Metastasis, and Tumor Malignancy
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the mechanisms of local invasion and distant metastasis that distinguish malignant neoplasms from benign tumors.

topics.label: Stepwise Progression in Colorectal Cancer
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic uses colorectal histology to illustrate the stepwise transition from a benign precursor polyp to an invasive adenocarcinoma.

topics.label: Progression and Pathological Risks of Benign Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses the varying progression risks of benign tumors and the mechanisms through which non-malignant growths can still cause fatal harm.

topics.label: Nomenclature of Benign and Malignant Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic outlines the standard conventions and notable exceptions used to classify and name tumors according to tissue origin and malignancy.

topics.label: Pathophysiological Mechanisms of Cancer Morbidity and Mortality
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains the physiological, mechanical, and systemic processes through which tumors and metastases cause illness and death.

topics.label: Epidemiology and Comparative Incidence of Tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics analyze how tumor incidence and mortality vary across different human tissues, demographics, and animal species.

topics.label: Principles and Clinical Applications of Cancer Screening
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics evaluate the clinical rationale, diagnostic techniques, and practical efficacy of screening programs across various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture Conclusion and Practical Preview
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic closes the lecture by reviewing the learning outcomes and looking ahead to the upcoming practical session.
